نتواكل (form VI)
# نَتَوَاكَلُ (natawākalu) /na.ta.waː.ka.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَوَاكَلَ (tawākala)
# نُتَوَاكَلُ (nutawākalu) /nu.ta.waː.ka.lu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of تَوَاكَلَ (tawākala)
# نَتَوَاكَلَ (natawākala) /na.ta.waː.ka.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَوَاكَلَ (tawākala)
# نُتَوَاكَلَ (nutawākala) /nu
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
